blocks.content: A Joint State PSC can be created for two or more states by an Act of Parliament. The Chairman and members are appointed by the President.
A Joint State PSC can be created for two or more states by an Act of Parliament.

items: JSPSC is a statutory body (created by Parliament), not a constitutional body directly created by the Constitution.
Remember that members and the Chairman are appointed by the President, not by the Governors of the participating states.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: A Joint State Public Service Commission (JSPSC) serves two or more states simultaneously.
Establishment of a JSPSC requires an Act of Parliament.
The President of India holds the power to appoint the Chairman and members of a JSPSC.
